changes: New: DROPOUT, codec and link failures on FX1 or FX2, on the project's tempo.
BITS codes the track with ADPCM at 5 to 2 bits; RATE sets how many errors a step, MODE their kind: a held sample, a lost packet replayed, CD concealment.
FRZ freezes whole steps on their first frame (FRM); STEP sets the step, 1/32 to 1/4.
At the defaults, or MIX 0, the track is untouched.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
